Provident Real Estate proudly presents this luxury 2-bedroom apartment in Le Grand Chateau, JVC.

Experience refined living in this luxury 2-bedroom apartment in Le Grand Chateau, one of the most elegant and sought-after residences in Jumeirah Village Circle. Designed with a touch of classic European architecture, this spacious unit offers a perfect blend of sophistication and comfort.

Property Details:
• 2 Spacious Bedrooms with Built-in Wardrobes
• Bright Open-Plan Living & Dining Area
• High-Quality Finishes Throughout
• Fully-Fitted Kitchen
• Large Windows with Natural Light
• Elegant European-Inspired Design
• Well-Maintained Bathrooms
• Balcony with Community Views
• Central Air Conditioning
• Dedicated Parking Space

Residents enjoy premium amenities including a temperature-controlled swimming pool, fully equipped gym, landscaped gardens, and 24/7 security. Conveniently located, Le Grand Chateau offers easy access to major roads, retail outlets, dining options, and key destinations across Dubai.
